requirement: Two-step sign-in can be turned on in Seguridad
expected: Activar shows a QR code and the key; a wrong first code is refused; a right one shows ten recovery codes once, then Seguridad says Activa
preconditions: Accounts migrations applied; TOTP enabled in Supabase
steps: Mi cuenta › Seguridad › Activar verificación en dos pasos; type a wrong then a right code

requirement: The code is asked after the password only on a browser that is not signed in
expected: After the password, an account with the app lands on Escribe tu código; any guarded page sends it back there until a right code; then it goes to the page it was heading to
steps: Sign in on a new browser; open /mi-cuenta/favoritos before the code; type a wrong and a right code

requirement: Mantener sesión iniciada keeps the session and its second step
expected: With the box ticked (default), closing and reopening the browser days later opens Mi cuenta without password or code
preconditions: Account with the app on; Supabase session time-box off or ≥ 30 days
steps: Sign in with the code, close the browser, reopen it after a day and open Mi cuenta

requirement: Unticking Mantener sesión iniciada ends the session with the browser
expected: The auth cookies are written without expiry, also after refreshes; reopening the browser asks to sign in
steps: Untick, sign in, inspect the sb-…-auth-token cookies, close and reopen the browser

requirement: The remember choice applies to the e-mail link and to Google or Apple
expected: recordar=0 reaches /auth/callback and the session cookies are session-only
steps: Untick, then sign in with the e-mail link

requirement: A recovery code lets the person in without the phone
expected: A good code removes the app, closes every session, sends the account_two_step_reset e-mail and leads to sign in again; a wrong code is refused; the sixth try in 15 minutes is refused
steps: Code step › No tengo mi teléfono; try wrong codes, then a right one

requirement: Recovery codes can be renewed and are counted
expected: Crear códigos nuevos (with confirmation) invalidates the old ten; Seguridad shows how many are left and nudges at three or fewer
steps: Seguridad › Crear códigos de recuperación nuevos

requirement: A store with an approved payment method requires the code for Mi tienda
expected: Without the app the owner is sent to set it up with the reason; with a first-step session, store contact and payment-method changes are refused (TWO_STEP_REQUIRED)
preconditions: Store with an approved payment method
steps: Open /mi-cuenta/tienda; call the store update RPCs from an aal1 session; tests/feat-accounts.sql

requirement: Admin pages require the code
expected: An Admin without the app is sent to set it up before any /admin page; with it, a first-step session goes to the code step
steps: Open /admin/ayuda as Admin before and after turning the app on

requirement: A Particular can turn the app off when it is not required
expected: Desactivar (with confirmation) removes the app; the button is absent when it is required

requirement: Seguridad lists the account's sessions
expected: Each session shows its browser label, last activity and (este dispositivo); only the account's own sessions appear

requirement: A single device can be signed out from Seguridad
expected: Cerrar sesión (with confirmation) ends that session; the other browser is signed out on its next request; another account's session cannot be closed
steps: Close the other session; reload it; tests/feat-accounts.sql

requirement: Cerrar sesión en todos los dispositivos ends every session
expected: Every session of the account ends, this one included, and the page lands on /login?motivo=sesiones
steps: Seguridad › Cerrar sesión en todos los dispositivos

requirement: A sign-in from a new browser sends one e-mail
expected: The first browser sends none; a later new browser sends account_new_device with the browser and Lima time; the same browser again sends none; at most ten a day
steps: Sign in from a second browser twice

requirement: The browser identifier is never stored in clear
expected: account_devices holds only a SHA-256 hash of the httpOnly laria_dispositivo cookie and a plain label

requirement: The sign-in e-mail can be changed from Seguridad
expected: Cambiar correo sends Supabase's confirmation; the page says Falta confirmar until it is opened; the old address keeps working until then; the link returns with a success notice
steps: Seguridad › Correo de acceso › Cambiar correo; open the link

requirement: E-mail change needs the second step when the account has the app
expected: A first-step session is refused with a message; an invalid or taken address is refused in Spanish

requirement: Descargar mis datos downloads the account's own data
expected: A JSON file laria-mis-datos-YYYY-MM-DD.json with account, listings, drafts, favorites, follows, alerts, reviews, purchases and sales, questions, help tickets, stolen-gear reports, devices and e-mail preferences; nothing from other accounts beyond what is public
steps: Tus datos › Descargar mis datos; tests/feat-accounts.sql

requirement: A Particular can delete the account
expected: After the password and one confirmation the profile becomes Cuenta eliminada, unsold listings are archived, personal lists are erased, the auth user is soft-deleted, the session ends and /login says Eliminamos tu cuenta; signing in again fails
steps: Tus datos › Eliminar mi cuenta with a wrong then the right password

requirement: Verified transactions and reviews survive a deletion
expected: Confirmed purchases and sales and their reviews stay, with the deleted side shown as Cuenta eliminada
preconditions: Account with a confirmed transaction and review
steps: Delete the account; open the other side's history; tests/feat-accounts.sql

requirement: Admin and store-owner accounts cannot delete themselves
expected: Tus datos explains why and links to the help center contact; the API refuses

requirement: An account that signs in only with Google or Apple confirms deletion by typing its e-mail
expected: The form asks for the e-mail instead of a password and refuses a different one

requirement: Deleting an account clears the branch's data through A20
expected: A20's anonymize_account (self-service or Admin) runs the branch's hook: personal rows removed or cleared, other people's records kept (the stand-in was removed at integration)

requirement: Google and Apple buttons appear only when enabled
expected: With NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_GOOGLE / NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_APPLE unset nothing renders; set to 1, the buttons show on /login and /registro/vendedor with the consent line
steps: Toggle the variables and open both pages

requirement: A first Google or Apple sign-in creates a Particular profile
expected: The callback creates a name-only seller profile; WhatsApp and city are asked at the first publication; the two-step code and the remember choice apply
steps: Continuar con Google with a new account

requirement: The help center answers common questions
expected: /ayuda shows four topics and 20 articles; each article has steps, links and related articles; unknown slugs return 404

requirement: Help search finds articles without accents
expected: contrasena, contraseña and two-word queries find the right articles as you type, and the GET form works without JavaScript
steps: Search contrasena, robo serie, cupo tienda

requirement: Anyone can send a question from the help center
expected: The form returns an AY- code; a signed-in person's name and e-mail come from the account; invalid fields are refused in Spanish

requirement: Help tickets are rate-limited
expected: The sixth ticket in 24 h from one e-mail or account and the eleventh in an hour from one browser hash are refused

requirement: Admin answers help tickets
expected: Admin › Ayuda lists tickets by status; Responder, Responder y cerrar, Cerrar sin responder and Reabrir work; a signed-in sender gets help_ticket_answered and sees the answer in Mis consultas; a ticket without an account offers Responder por correo
steps: Answer one ticket of each kind

requirement: People see only their own tickets
expected: Mis consultas lists only the signed-in person's tickets; non-Admins cannot call the Admin functions

requirement: The WhatsApp support line shows only when staffed
expected: Without both NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_HOURS no line shows; with both, the number and hours show

requirement: Every footer links the help center
expected: Full footer: Centro de ayuda; slim footer: Ayuda

requirement: A signed-in person can report stolen gear
expected: /reportar-robo saves brand, serial, description, up to six private photos, date, place and the required police report number, and returns an RB- code; signed out it asks to sign in; the sixth report in 24 h is refused

requirement: Report photos are private
expected: stolen-gear-photos is private; a person can upload, read and delete only under their own folder; Admin sees them through 10-minute signed links

requirement: Serials are private
expected: Listing and SKU serials never appear on public pages, public RPCs or exports of other accounts; only the owner (and store managers for SKUs) read them
steps: tests/feat-accounts.sql; view the listing as a visitor

requirement: Sellers can add a serial to a listing
expected: Número de serie on the edit form and on the sell success screen saves privately; stores add one per line on each SKU

requirement: A serial equal to an active report creates a match for Admin
expected: Matching ignores spaces, dashes and case, works whether the serial or the report comes first, and never matches the reporter's own listings

requirement: A listing photo close to a report photo creates a match
expected: A hashed listing photo within 5 of 64 bits of a report photo creates a photo match; near-flat images never match

requirement: Matches never accuse anyone in public
expected: Nothing changes on the listing; only a match Admin confirms e-mails the reporter, without the listing or seller; no copy says robado about a listing
steps: Confirm and reject matches in Admin › Equipos reportados

requirement: Reporters manage their reports
expected: Mis reportes lists the person's reports with confirmed matches counted; Lo recuperé and Retirar reporte close a report and stop matching

requirement: Admin reviews reports by status
expected: Equipos reportados lists matches and reports by status, and Admin can close a report with a reason

requirement: Other features can check a serial
expected: flag_serial_against_stolen_reports(serial, source, ref, owner) accepts gear from Mi equipo and skips the owner's own reports

requirement: Copied photos between different sellers raise a flag
expected: Photos within 5 of 64 bits on listings of different owners put a photo_copy flag on the newer listing naming the other listing and photos; same-owner duplicates and near-flat images do not

requirement: Flags never block a listing
expected: A flagged listing keeps its status; Admin decides with the usual approve or reject

requirement: Admin sees flags while reviewing
expected: The review queue shows Foto parecida a la de otro vendedor and Coincide con un reporte above the listing, with links; opening an unhashed listing hashes it first

requirement: Admin resolves photo flags
expected: Fotos repetidas shows both photos and the distance; Es una copia and No es copia close the flag with an optional note; filters show past decisions

requirement: The photo-hash job is safe to repeat
expected: GET /api/internal/jobs/photo-fingerprints needs CRON_SECRET, hashes pending listings first, re-hashes a listing only when its photos change and stops within 45 s

requirement: Only Laria's own photos are fetched
expected: Photos outside the project's Storage buckets and the private /api/listing-images paths are skipped
steps: Hash a listing with an outside image URL

requirement: The fingerprint and flag tables are closed to clients
expected: RLS is on with no grants; only the service role and Admin functions read or write them

requirement: The batch's e-mails are in Spanish and transactional
expected: account_new_device, account_two_step_reset, help_ticket_answered and stolen_report_match render with their links and no unsubscribe line

requirement: The new pages meet WCAG 2.2 AA
expected: axe finds no violations on the new pages and states at 390 and 1366 px (a11y-accounts.json); every action has a button of at least 24 px

requirement: The new pages read well at 390 and 1366 px
expected: Screenshots in /mnt/project-files/feature-ideas/screens/accounts/ show no overflow or wrapped tabs

requirement: Admin navigation shows the new sections
expected: Ayuda, Fotos repetidas and Equipos reportados appear in the Admin menu and are Admin-only
steps: Open /admin as Admin and as a Particular

requirement: Help tickets and stolen reports appear in the data export
expected: Both lists are in the downloaded file for their author only

requirement: Deleting an account cleans this batch's data
expected: The account's help tickets, stolen-gear reports (and their photos), devices, recovery codes, listing serials and photo hashes are deleted

requirement: The local prototype supports the new flows
expected: The gateway stand-in handles factors, sessions, scoped sign-out, Admin user calls and signed URLs; the a11y scripts pass the code step
steps: bash scripts/prototype/start-docker-free.sh seed; run the a11y scripts
